prompts.name: nav-raven
prompts.prompt: One isolated raven emblem for dark Nordic RPG UI, genuinely transparent background. Side profile facing left, proud upright head, thick beak, folded wing and compact tail, two sturdy feet. Shallow cast aged bronze relief, muted brown bronze face, dark recessed edges, worn pale upper-left bevel. Bold simplified planes, only three broad feather cuts. Front-on orthographic icon, centred with ample transparent margin, no medallion or backdrop, no lettering, no glow, no photoreal bird. Strong readable silhouette at 40 pixels. Match hand-forged bronze over charcoal leather aesthetic.

prompts.name: nav-knot
prompts.prompt: One isolated angular Nordic three-triangle interlocking knot emblem for a dark RPG navigation tab, truly transparent background. Thick continuous triangular bronze bands with three clearly separated triangular openings. Compact balanced triangular silhouette, broad simple geometric planes. Shallow cast aged bronze relief, muted brown bronze face, dark recessed edges, worn pale upper-left bevel. Front-on orthographic, generous margins. Reads at 40 pixels. No medallion, backdrop, lettering, glow or extra symbols. Same hand-forged aged bronze material as a Nordic raven emblem.

prompts.name: nav-shield

Front-on orthographic centred, generous transparent margins. No medallion, background, letters, glow or elaborate engraving. Same hand-forged bronze family as raven and triangular knot.
